sources.title: Autonomous Car with ESP32-CAM & Python - GitHub
sources.snippet: This project implements a small autonomous car controlled by an ESP32‑CAM board (used as a microcontroller) and a Python script running on a host computer. A smartphone running the IP Webcam app provides the video feed, streaming to the host computer over the local network.
